Subject: Vendor master request — FluxEng (legal name, remit, contacts)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — excited to move forward. To create FluxEng in our vendor master and enable POs, AP needs: legal entity name, tax ID (EIN), entity type, registered address, remit address, preferred invoice email, AP contact name/phone, and a W9 (or local tax form). If you can also confirm whether payments will be via ACH or wire and provide bank details (routing/account or US equivalent), that will speed up activation.

What we typically capture:
- Legal name: (inc. DBA if any)
- Entity type: Corporation / LLC / Sole prop
- Tax ID / EIN
- Registered address (legal)
- Remit address for invoices
- Invoice submission email and preferred PO routing
- AP contact (name / email / phone)
- Authorized signer name and title for contracts

Can you send the W9 and a short attachment with banking/remit info? We can treat bank info as restricted; you can either attach it here or send to ap@redwood.com.

Target timeline: add to vendor master by EOD Mon so procurement can issue the initial PO. Let me know if you need our vendor master template.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Elena / Maria — thanks for the packet. A couple quick items so finance can map this correctly into our ERP: 

1) Remit vs registered: you listed a PO Box for remit and a street address for registered — perfect. Can you confirm whether invoices will show the PO Box or the street address? We need the exact invoice header for matching.

2) Beneficial owner / UBO: our audit process asks for the percent ownership or confirmation that there are no individual owners >25%. If you can confirm or provide the UBO declaration we can record this as part of vendor compliance.

3) Bank detail question: in the spreadsheet you provided, the routing column is blank for one bank. Is that a wire-only account or can you provide ACH routing? If you prefer, Maria can email the bank sheet directly to ap@redwood.com and mark it restricted.

If you send the UBO note and confirm invoice header, we should be able to create the vendor and issue the PO early next week.

Thanks — cc'ing Kimberly to confirm AP mapping.

Best,
David
